name: Hailey
summary: Instagram creator behind the account @xxhayjxx (~127k followers), which has been disabled since April 2026; she was referred by Lilia. She reached out to get the account recovered and was quoted by the rep, agreeing to pay via Zelle (no crypto) the following Monday, but was very anxious about guarantees/refunds because two prior people took her money and failed. She has no password and a previous 'fixer' (WhatsApp contact 'POLAT') changed the recovery email and appealed repeatedly — screenshots show Meta escalating from 'disabled' to 'permanently deleted, no further review.' Conversation went quiet after 6/12 and ended 6/22 with her confused ('I don't know what that means'), so payment and outcome are unconfirmed — worth a follow-up to confirm whether she ever paid and whether the account is recoverable.
